title: My Big Adventure
description: My Big Adventure is a adventure inspired modpack that adds extra structures and terrain while trying to keep the vanilla feel.
body:
## **My Big Adventure — A Vanilla-Plus Adventure Modpack**

**My Big Adventure is a lightweight, vanilla-friendly modpack designed for players who want the classic Minecraft feel with just the right amount of adventure, exploration, and discovery added on top. This pack keeps the core gameplay intact while expanding the world with new structures, biomes, dungeons, companions, and quality-of-life features that make every world feel richer and more alive.**


## **What This Modpack Adds**

- **New world structures and points of interest**

  Discover fresh dungeons, hidden ruins, improved villages, and natural landmarks that blend seamlessly into the vanilla aesthetic.
  

- **Expanded exploration & world variety**

  Biome improvements, new underground features, and subtle terrain enhancements make exploration more rewarding without feeling modded.


- **Lightweight adventure content**

  Handful of new enchantments, simple item additions, and new loot sources create exciting moments without overwhelming players.

- **Improved immersion**

  Ambient upgrades, better world generation, and small environment details while supporting shaderpacks make every journey feel more atmospheric.

- **Quality-of-life improvements**

  Performance optimizations, helpful utility mods, and small enhancements ensure the game runs smoothly while keeping mechanics familiar.
